hints.title: Maintain Most Recent Indices
hints.text: Keep track of the most recent index where characters a, b, and c occurred as you scan through the string.

hints.title: Valid Prefix Count
hints.text: At current index i, any valid substring ending at i must start at or before min(last_a, last_b, last_c).

hints.title: Single Pass Accumulation
hints.text: If all three characters have been seen, min(last_a, last_b, last_c) + 1 substrings end at index i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substrings takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the latest occurrences of a, b, c allows counting all valid starts in O(1) time per character.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes min(last_a, last_b, last_c) + 1 gives the count of valid starting points directly.
complexity.notes: Initial positions are -1, adding 0 until all three have appeared.

solutions.approach: last-seen index tracking for O(1) start point counting
